title: Asia/MENA coverage evidence tranche 1A - Oman, Bahrain, Georgia, Singapore, UAE

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Royal Oman Police operates the eVisa portal at evisa.rop.gov.om as the official online visa service for the Sultanate of Oman.
The Kingdom of Bahrain operates the Bahrain Electronic Visa Service at evisa.gov.bh as the only official website to apply for a visa to Bahrain.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia operates the e-VISA PORTAL at evisa.gov.ge/GeoVisa as the official online visa service for short-term visits to Georgia.
The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority of Singapore operates ica.gov.sg as the official government portal for identity documents and entering, transiting and departing Singapore.

The Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) operates icp.gov.ae/en/ as the official UAE federal portal for identity, citizenship, residency and port-security services.

batch.name: v10.22.13 Asia/MENA evidence tranche 1A - OM, BH, GE, SG, AE
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Oman (OM), Bahrain (BH), Georgia (GE), Singapore (SG) and the United Arab Emirates (AE). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable English-language immigration, visa or residency content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Royal Oman Police eVisa official portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Royal Oman Police operates the eVisa portal at evisa.rop.gov.om as the official online visa service for the Sultanate of Oman. This supports a proposal that Oman directly administers the relevant visa and immigration services through the Royal Oman Police.

source_onboarding.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-18 with status local_probe_passed. The Royal Oman Police eVisa portal returned HTTPS 200 with English content describing online visa services for the Sultanate of Oman. Keep the initial certification limited to the visa services explicitly described.
